title: Must do Cava and Chocolate Adventure
text:
Small group, intimate, friendly, professional.  This adventure was one of our trip highlights.  Everything about this trip is excellent - the village is both fun and pretty, the chocolate factory fabulous as was the Cava experience.  The lunch is optional and of high quality, and I strongly recommend it.  
In all this day was fantastic.  
And let me tell you that lots of things that were outside of the tour organiser's control chose that day to go wrong.  And Christian & Michael worked tirelessly to make the day magical and fun despite the universe conspiring otherwise.  Everyone was laughing
author: Wendy_P

title: The highlight of our trip
text: We had an absolutely amazing time during this tour! Michael was very knowledgeable and everyone we met was very friendly. The chocolate tour was incredible, we got to see the different parts of the chocolate making process and taste the different parts of the coco bean and chocolate derivatives. The cava tour was at a local family run winery and we got to see old cellars and taste delicious types of cava. I would highly recommend anyone considering to book with them. They were very flexible when the train was unavailable and picked us up by car. 10/10!
author: Jalisa_H

title: Beautiful Day in Spanish Countryside
text: We had a lovely day with Michael in the countryside outside Barcelona. The tour was very intimate (the four members of my family) and educational. The tour took place in a quiet countryside town, which was a welcome break from Barcelona. Michael connected with all the ages and personalities in my family. We made a quick stop for a Cava tasting outside the train stop then on to the chocolate tour, which was very delicious. Then had a great lunch at a local restaurant. title: A very special tour
text: Amazing tour to the birth place of the sparkling wine. You visit the factory of Freixenette and a wonderful small winery and get to taste delicious Cava. The guide Christian is knowledgeable and charming. A wonderful day in the spanish countryside outside of Bercelona.

title: STOP. This is the tour you want
text: This is fun. Michael & Christian, first-rate guides, take you to a magical village one hour from Barcelona to enjoy some of the world's best chocolate and cava in the place where they are made. If you choose, you can also enjoy a world class luncheon (extra charge is worth it). What better way to spend your day?
author: Sunnerhi

title: Intimate Champagne and Chocolate Getaway
text:
Have you always wanted to roam the wine cellar of a winegrower in private? Find out more on the spot? Have a friend with you who can explain what you have seen? Who will open every door in the deep cellar and show you all the secrets of the production of a real cava? And to top it all off, opens the bottles you've just seen under shady trees in a gentle breeze and hands them to you to taste?
Then you should definitely get in touch with Christian and Michael. We will never forget this remarkable day in Sant Sadurní d'Anoia.
A typical Spanish lunch is served in a restaurant where only locals eat
